entries.reason: The recipe build models the docs body by hand; the capture reads the host page's body rule, under its own name.
The page's body rule and Fuse's base layer on it, as the browser applies them.
Tailwind's preflight and Fuse's base layer on `<html>`, as the browser applies them.
Fuse's base layer, which the recipe build modelled only for the border color: box sizing, zero border, margin and padding.
The browser's default style for the element, which the recipe build modelled only for `display`.

CSS clips nothing here (`overflow` is `visible` initially, CSS Overflow 3 §3) and the set's root casts no shadow in any cell, so the capture-backed root leaves its layers unclipped, and a ring at its edge shows as in the browser. A root that casts a shadow still clips, since Figma draws a spread only from a clipping frame (PR2).
The recipe build compiled `rounded-full` from source, `calc(infinity * 1px)`.
Fuse's built CSS writes `rounded-full`'s infinite radius as `3.40282e38px`, the largest float, which reads as the same infinite radius and draws the same corner.
